openLimitHelp: How many tickets one member may have open at once.
panelColorHelp: The bar down the left of the embed.
panelHelp: What the panel looks like in Discord. Leave a field empty to use the wording shown under it.
repostHelp: Save first, then repost: Discord cannot edit a panel from an earlier session, so the old message is deleted and a fresh one posted.
staffRolesEmpty: Your roles could not be listed, so this cannot be changed right now.
staffRolesHelp: These roles see and can claim every ticket. Leave all unticked to use your staff roles.
archiveHelp: Closed tickets move here instead of being deleted. Leave unset to delete them.
categoryHelp: New ticket channels are created under this category.
channelHelp: Where the Open a ticket panel is posted.
logHelp: Close summaries and transcripts land here. Falls back to your staff log channel.
help: Posts an Open a ticket panel and handles claims, closes and transcripts.
label: Support tickets
sectionHelp: A panel members click to open a private channel with your staff.
title: Ticket desk
transcriptHelp: On close, the whole conversation is saved and posted to the ticket log as a text file.
staffRoleMissingHelp: A selected role was deleted from the server. Untick it to clear it.
